template: Examine every shape and where it sits relative to the centre of the arrangement: work out which shapes pair with which, decide whether the pattern is fully symmetric or whether one element has been displaced from where its partner requires it to be, and say what kind of symmetry the arrangement is built on. State your conclusion, justify it by describing which shapes you paired and how you judged their positions, and end with a confidence score from 0 to 1.

independent_derivation.method: separate formulas and geometry traversals; generator answer derivation is not called

deterministic_subfact_dependency_check.method: For every target sub-fact, test every 1-to-3-field subset of the other populated sub-facts. A relation is flagged when every repeated predictor tuple maps to one target and repeated tuples cover at least 80% of eligible rows. Explicit prohibited semantic identities remain validation failures.

pattern_status.visual_signal: paired shape locations around the rendered centre
pattern_status.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery

symmetry_type.visual_signal: rendered rotational orbit or mirror pairing
symmetry_type.verification_basis: exhaustive PNG decode plus domain renderer/geometry recovery
